component.name: Compass
component.summary: A Chromium browser with your tabs in a sidebar

description.p: Compass keeps Chromium's engine, extensions and security model, and replaces the tab strip with a sidebar.

ul.li: Spaces: separate sets of tabs, each with its own colors and profile
Pinned tabs and folders, kept as you left them
Split view: two tabs side by side in one window
A command bar, and Peek to preview a link without opening a tab
Sync without an account, end-to-end encrypted
